evals.prompt: Crie uma proposta de valor B2B da Atomica para uma startup Seed-Série B com meta trimestral de pipeline e time de marketing pequeno.
evals.expected_output: A response that selects the startup ICP, uses SQLs or qualified meetings as the primary metric, frames Atomica as a Marketing Transformation Partner with AI, includes a 7-second anchor, and maps proof to efficiency, quality, and speed.

evals.prompt: Transforme a oferta B2B de quick win da Atomica em uma sequência de landing page para PME digitalizada.
evals.expected_output: A landing-page sequence that routes to execution/quick wins, uses qualified leads and time savings as core proof, avoids generic AI-tool positioning, and includes a 14-30 day proof or POC mechanism.

evals.prompt: Adapte a mensagem B2C da Atomica para vender a mentoria de IA para profissionais de marketing no Brasil.
evals.expected_output: A PT-BR-oriented B2C message for the mentorship, using the 4-week practical capability anchor, operational marketer JTBD, proof across efficiency/quality/speed, and guardrails against prompt-pack or magic-formula positioning.
